title: Tamon’s B-Side
label: Quick read (from summaries)
premise: High schooler Utage Kinoshita works as a part-time housekeeper to fund her devotion to Tamon Fukuhara, the bold 'wild boy' of idol group F/ACE. Assigned to his home, she finds the real Tamon is gloomy, insecure and friendless, his stage persona set by his agency. She makes it her mission to keep him going as an idol while sorting out the gap between the star and the person.
life_message: Encouragement and honest support can help a struggling person keep going at work they care about, even when the public image differs from the private self.

folkways.japan: Oshikatsu (spending to support a favorite idol) and agency-managed idol images are established Japanese pop-culture practices that the series plays for comedy.
